title: LDT7808 — Water supply check (LQC mode)
description: LQC fill check: Power+Start, then Start ×5 for supply sound.

source.manualTitle: LG LDT7808 Top-Control Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Enter LQC water check
steps.body: Press Power + Start. Press Start 5 times and listen for water supplying sound. Press Power to turn off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: How to Check Water supply (LQC Mode)
